project_type: Python FastAPI app - AI content quality scorer (scam radar)
test_framework: pytest with pytest-asyncio (asyncio_mode='auto'), pytest-cov for coverage
verification_instructions: Run pytest tests/ --cov=src --cov-report=term-missing and verify coverage >= 75%
environment_constraints: OPEN_INTERNET available. No playwright browser installed. LLM APIs not available (mock in tests).
contribution_requirements: Think before coding, simplicity first, surgical changes, tests verify intent, match codebase conventions
key_patterns: Tests in tests/ directory, one test file per module. conftest.py has shared fixtures (mock_llm_response, sample_junk_text, sample_good_text, tmp_db_path, mock_config). Use unittest.mock for LLM calls. Async tests use pytest-asyncio auto mode. Pydantic models in src/models/score.py. PipelineContext is the core data structure passed through stages.
directory_structure: src/ has sub-packages: api/, auth/, cli/, core/, dispatcher/, extractors/, models/, monitor/, preferences/, storage/, thunder/, web/. Tests all in tests/ flat directory.
